And when we're co-located, the world of mouth is much more effective. The things the firms can do through their own actions like good prices, good delivery, great customer service that will generate word of mouth. I get you 25% off my next pair, creating some kind of a virtuous self-regenerating word of mouth through giving your best customers incentives I think is very, very powerful. So I think firms certainly need to know what's being said about them. They certainly need to take an active role.
